# zvm command reference

Generated from zvm's CLI definition. Every command and flag below is
real; anything not listed here does not exist.

`zvm` — Zig Version Manager

## Global flags

- `--color` — enable (on, yes/y, enabled, true) or disable (off, no/n, disabled, false) colored ZVM output
- `--help`, `-h` — show help
- `--version`, `-v` — print the version

## `zvm install`

Download and install a version of Zig

Aliases: `zvm i`

Arguments: `<ZIG VERSION>`

To install the latest version, use `master`

- `--zls` — install ZLS
- `--force`, `-f` — force installation even if the version is already installed
- `--skip-shasum`, `-s` — skip SHA-256 verification and the unverified-download confirmation
- `--skip-use`, `-k` — install without setting the version as active
- `--full` — use the 'full' zls compatibility mode
- `--nomirror` — download Zig from ziglang.org instead of a community mirror
- `--target-os` — override the target operating system (e.g., linux, macos, windows, freebsd)
- `--target-arch` — override the target architecture (e.g., x86_64, aarch64, arm, riscv64)
- `--http.timeout` — set a custom timeout for http requests

## `zvm use`

Switch between versions of Zig

- `--sync` — sync your current version of Zig with the repository

## `zvm run`

Run a command with the given Zig version

## `zvm list-remote`

List all remote Zig versions

Aliases: `zvm ls-remote`

- `--json` — print remote Zig versions as JSON

## `zvm list`

List installed Zig versions.

Aliases: `zvm ls`

- `--all`, `-a` — list remote Zig versions available for download, based on your version map
- `--vmu` — list set version maps

## `zvm alias`

Give an installed Zig version a name

Aliases: `zvm kv`

- `--clear` — clear all aliases
- `--delete`, `-d` — delete the alias for the given name

## `zvm uninstall`

Remove an installed version of Zig

Aliases: `zvm rm`

## `zvm clean`

Remove build artifacts (good if you're a scrub)

## `zvm upgrade`

Self-upgrade ZVM

## `zvm mirrorlist`

Set ZVM's mirror list URL for custom Zig distribution servers, or set to "disabled" to download directly from ziglang.org

## `zvm bug`

Start a bug report

Open a prefilled ZVM issue in your browser.
The report includes your ZVM version, settings, and host details.
Paths under your home directory are shortened to ~, and custom mirror
or version-map URLs are replaced by a digest. Review it before submitting.

- `--print` — print the report URL instead of opening a browser

## `zvm version`

Print the current version of ZVM

## `zvm vmu`

Set ZVM's version map URL for custom Zig distribution servers

## `zvm vmu zig`

Set ZVM's version map URL for custom Zig distribution servers

## `zvm vmu zls`

Set ZVM's version map URL for custom ZLS Release Workers

## `zvm completion`

Generate a shell completion script for `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, or `pwsh`.
Generated by urfave/cli rather than declared in main.go.
